trajectory.raw_text:
The HTTP request handling pipeline in Django starts with `BaseHandler._get_response`, which resolves the request to a view callback using `BaseHandler.resolve_request`. The view callback is then wrapped and invoked. If an exception is raised during the invocation, it is caught and processed by the exception middleware in `BaseHandler.process_exception_by_middleware`.

